name: openjml
description: JML specification type-checking for Java via OpenJML

openjml.triggerOn.markdownDescription:
When to run OpenJML:
- `edit` — check on every change (instant feedback, higher CPU)
- `save` — check only when the file is saved (lower overhead, good for large projects)

openjml.mode.markdownDescription:
Check mode:
- `check` — JML type-checking only (fast)
- `esc` — extended static checking via SMT solver (thorough but slow)

openjml.specsPath.description: Path to the OpenJML specs directory. Leave empty to use the default from the launcher script.

openjml.solversPath.description: Path to the SMT solvers directory. Leave empty to use the default from the launcher script.
